question: Who among the following was awarded the French honour of ‘Chevalier dans I'Ordre des Arts et des Lettres’ (Knight of the Order of Arts and Letters) in January 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sanjana Kapoor.__** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Noted theatre personality **Sanjana Kapoor (daughter of famous Bollywood actor Shashi Kapoor)**, has been awarded the prestigious French honour, Knight of the Order of Arts and Letters due to her **outstanding contributions in the field of Theatre Arts.**
 
• 
 
**French Cultural Minister Franck Riester,** conferred this special distinction on **Sanjana Kapoor** in a special investiture ceremony on **January 28, 2020.**

 
 
• 
 
**Sanjana Kapoor **is the daughter of former actor **Shashi Kapoor**, who started her film career from Aparna Sen’s famous movie **"36 Chowringhee Lane" in the year 1981.**

 
 
• 
 
She also acted in films like** Hero Hiralal (1989) and Mira Nair’s Salaam Bombay (1988).**

 
 
• 
 
After some time, she decided to work fully in the field of theatre arts by acting in plays and also redeveloping the famous **Prithvi Theatre in Mumbai** which was founded by her parents.

 
 
• 
 
Some noted Indian awardees of this award include **Bharti Kher, Shahrukh Khan, Pt Hariprasad Chaurasia, Aishwarya Rai, Raghu Rai, Ebrahim Alkazi, Habib Tanveer, Upamanyu Chatterjee, Wendell Rodricks, and Aruna Vasudev, **to name a few.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Ordre des Arts et des Lettres (Order of the Arts and the Letters) **is an order of France established on **2 May 1957** by **the Minister of Culture.**
 
• Its purpose is to recognize the significant contributions made in **the field of arts and literature both nationally and internationally.**
 
• The medallion is worn on a ribbon, beneath the left shoulder and is given to** not more than 200 recipients a year.**

The figure shows the image of the award.** **
